pieces.name: confirm_seller
pieces.description: The seller confirms it accepts the order.

pieces.name: review_unusual_order
pieces.description: A person reviews the order before it goes on.

when.jev: A person should review this order before it goes on, because it does not look like a normal consumer purchase: resale-like quantities of the same product (dozens of units) or an odd mix of items that suggests fraud.

pieces.name: fraud_check
pieces.description: Sends the order to the anti-fraud provider, which returns a risk score.

pieces.name: evaluate_fraud_score
pieces.description: Turns the anti-fraud score into a decision.

pieces.name: payment
pieces.description: Waits for the payment of the order to be approved.

pieces.name: release_items
pieces.description: Releases every item of the order to be fulfilled.

pieces.name: request_prescription
pieces.description: Asks the buyer for the medical prescription and validates it before the item is handled.

when.jev: To sell this item, a medical prescription must be collected from the buyer and validated.

pieces.name: pharmacist_review
pieces.description: A pharmacist approves a controlled medicine sold in more than two units.

when.jev: Selling this quantity of this item needs a pharmacist's approval, because it is a controlled or prescription-only medicine.

pieces.name: verify_age
pieces.description: Checks that the buyer is an adult before the item is handled.

when.jev: Before selling this item, the seller must confirm the buyer is an adult (alcoholic drinks, tobacco or vapes, adult content).

pieces.name: reserve_stock
pieces.description: Ready-made physical product: reserves stock at the best origin (store or distribution center) of the seller.

pieces.name: produce_to_order
pieces.description: Made-to-order or personalized physical product (engraving, tailoring, furniture built on demand): produced after purchase, there is no stock to reserve.

pieces.name: deliver_digital
pieces.description: Purely digital product (download, e-mail, license key): delivered electronically, nothing physical is shipped.

pieces.name: wait_restock
pieces.description: Waits for the item to be restocked at some origin of the seller.

pieces.name: start_handling
pieces.description: The origin handles the item until it is ready to ship.

pieces.name: issue_invoice
pieces.description: Issues the invoice (NF-e) that must travel with the item.

pieces.name: require_special_transport
pieces.description: Books a certified carrier for an item that ordinary carriers refuse to take.

when.jev: Ordinary parcel carriers refuse to take this item and it must go with a certified special carrier (for example power banks or loose lithium batteries, fuels, gas cylinders, corrosive chemicals).

pieces.name: ship_standard
pieces.description: Ordinary parcel shipping: small or medium item, no refrigeration and no delivery urgency.

pieces.name: ship_express
pieces.description: Express parcel shipping: the item is urgent or needs fast delivery, without refrigeration.

pieces.name: ship_cold_chain
pieces.description: Refrigerated express shipping: perishable, frozen or chilled item that needs cold chain.

pieces.name: ship_heavy_freight
pieces.description: Scheduled freight for large or heavy items that do not fit a parcel carrier: home appliances, furniture, mattresses.

pieces.name: wait_delivery
pieces.description: Waits for the carrier to deliver the item.

pieces.name: return_window
pieces.description: Keeps the item open for return after delivery: the buyer may send it back, sealed or unused, within the return period (ordinary goods, including a physical gift card that was not used).

when.jev: Once delivered, this item can still be accepted back from the buyer if it comes back sealed or unused (ordinary goods, a physical gift card that was not used). It cannot for medicines, perishable or frozen food, personal hygiene products, and custom-made or engraved items.

pieces.name: close_without_return
pieces.description: Closes the item right after delivery with no return, because once delivered it cannot be taken back: medicines, perishable or frozen food, personal hygiene products, custom-made or engraved items.

when.jevNot: Once delivered, this item can still be accepted back from the buyer if it comes back sealed or unused (ordinary goods, a physical gift card that was not used). It cannot for medicines, perishable or frozen food, personal hygiene products, and custom-made or engraved items.

pieces.name: process_return
pieces.description: Receives the returned item and refunds the buyer.
